text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both up roughly 3-4% over 24 hours despite an Extreme Fear reading, suggesting conviction is pushing prices higher even as sentiment metrics remain deeply pessimistic. Bitcoin dominance at 58.9% and $61B in daily volume indicate steady participation rather than panic liquidations or euphoric speculation. The modest gains across major altcoins (BNB, SOL) paired with flat Fear & Greed momentum implies a cautious, measured recovery rather than a capitulation bottom or breakout rally.
